daily_wisdom: The market doesn't reward patience in momentum trades — it rewards discipline. Take half your profits when the stock gives them to you, move your stop to breakeven, and let the other half ride for free. The biggest mistake aggressive traders make isn't entering too early — it's watching a 20% winner turn into a 10% loser because they couldn't bring themselves to sell. Profits aren't real until they're in your account.
